Due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], the schedule had been changed to begin on 7 March instead of 21 February as originally planned.{{cite web | url=https://znews.vn/virus-corona-khien-cac-giai-bong-da-viet-nam-tam-hoan-post1042093.html | title=Virus corona khiến các giải bóng đá Việt Nam tạm hoãn | date=2 February 2020 | access-date=2 February 2020 | archive-date=2 February 2020 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200202075000/https://news.zing.vn/virus-corona-khien-cac-giai-bong-da-viet-nam-tam-hoan-post1042093.html | url-status=live }} All matches in matchdays 1 and 2 were played behind closed doors due to the same reason. Following the stabilizing situation, the league resumed in June, and also became the first league to allow fans into the stadium post-[[COVID-19]] outbreak.{{Cite web|url=https://www.firstpost.com/sports/coronavirus-outbreak-vietnams-top-flight-football-league-resumes-with-fans-in-attendance-8455091.html|title=Coronavirus Outbreak: Vietnam's top-flight football league resumes with fans in attendance |website=firstpost.com |date=6 June 2020}} On 26 July 2020, the league was suspended again due to another surge in COVID-19 cases.{{Cite web|url=https://www.besoccer.com/new/vietnam-suspends-domestic-football-after-new-covid-cases-865372|title=Vietnam suspends domestic football after new COVID cases|website=besoccer.com|date=26 July 2020|access-date=17 September 2020|archive-date=17 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210717165330/https://www.besoccer.com/new/vietnam-suspends-domestic-football-after-new-covid-cases-865372|url-status=dead}} ==Changes from last season== ===Team changes=== The following teams have changed division since the 2019 season. {{col-begin|width=50em}} {{col-2}} ====To V.League 1==== '''Promoted from [[2019 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Hong Linh Ha Tinh FC|Hong Linh Ha Tinh]]{{cite web|url=https://vietnamnews.vn/sports/535811/hong-linh-ha-tinh-win-promotion-to-vleague-1-phu-dong-relegated.html#0F7pklu517hS0JPr.97|title=Hồng Lĩnh Hà Tĩnh win promotion to V.League 1, Phù Đồng relegated|website=vietnamnews.vn}} {{col-2}} ====From V.League 1==== '''Relegated to [[2020 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Khanh Hoa FC|Sanna Khanh Hoa BVN]]{{cite web|url=https://vietnamnews.vn/sports/537383/thanh-hoa-secure-play-off-match-khanh-hoa-dropped.html#Kw4x5RCqHUMHqL0D.99|title=Thanh Hóa secure play-off match, Khánh Hòa dropped|website=vietnamnews.vn}} {{col-end}} ===Rules changes=== In the 2020 season, each team could register 3+1 foreign players (3 foreign + 1 naturalized Vietnamese). The teams that participated in ASEAN Club Championship and AFC Cup ([[Ho Chi Minh City FC|Ho Chi Minh City]], [[Hanoi FC|Hanoi]], [[Than Quang Ninh FC|Than Quang Ninh]]) could register 3+1+1 foreign players (3 foreign + 1 naturalized Vietnamese + 1 AFC player)
On 13 May 2020, the format had been slightly changed, including: * The 1st leg will remain unchanged. * After the 1st leg, teams will be split into 2 groups: ** Championship group (Group A) will include the top 8 teams in the 1st leg. ** Relegation group (Group B) will include the bottom 6 teams in the 1st leg. * Each group will play another single round-robin format. After the end of season: ** The champions will qualify for the [[2021 AFC Champions League|2021 AFC Champions League group stage]]. ** The runners-up and the cup winners, [[Hanoi FC|Hanoi]] (or the league 3rd-placers if [[Hanoi FC|Hanoi]] qualified for AFC Club Competitions through league performance) will qualify for the [[2021 AFC Cup|2021 AFC Cup group stage]]. ** The 14th-ranked team will be relegated to 2021 V.League 2. There's no relegation playoff for this season. and the 13th-ranked team will stay in V.League 1 2021. ==Teams==
